items.stem: After ChatGPT reports a total from an uploaded sheet, what is the best verification step?

options.text: Recompute a sample independently and compare
options.rationale: Correct: an independent spot check confirms the figure was computed from the full, correct data.

options.text: Accept it because the tool computed it
options.rationale: Automated computation can still use mis-read or partial data; a check is needed.

options.text: Ask the model to say it again

options.rationale: Presentation does not confirm the underlying number.

items.explanation: Correct: an independent spot check confirms the figure was computed from the full, correct data.

items.stem: Which chart best shows a single metric changing over 12 months?

options.rationale: Correct: a line chart is designed to show a continuous value changing over ordered time.
Pie charts show parts of a whole at one point, not change over time.
A single number cannot show the trend across months.
A word cloud visualises text frequency, not a numeric time series.

items.explanation: Correct: a line chart is designed to show a continuous value changing over ordered time.

items.stem: Which TWO are good practices before trusting an AI analysis of an upload? (Select TWO)

options.text: Confirm the row/record count matches the source
options.rationale: Correct: verifying the record count ensures the whole dataset was used.

options.text: Spot-check at least one calculation by hand
options.rationale: Correct: a manual recomputation catches calculation or data-reading errors.

options.text: Assume all columns were interpreted correctly
options.rationale: Column meanings can be misread; this should be checked, not assumed.

options.text: Pick the chart that looks most dramatic
options.rationale: Choosing for drama can misrepresent the data.

items.explanation: Correct: verifying the record count ensures the whole dataset was used.
